comment.name: Millard J Melnyk
comment.body:
From one of my favorite Substacks.

Although I’d rather a variation on Proudhon’s statement:

Whoever lays a hand upon me is a usurper and tyrant, and I declare myself their enemy.

Me? I have no enemies. No one is strong enough nor smart enough to be my enemy.

Idiots don’t constitute enemies. We make FAR too much of them.

https://lionessofjudah.substack.com/p/the-government-slaughter-in-lahaina
